arabic text: KHOON ROTA HAI MUSALA AUR NAMAZE DILFIGAR\nHOGAYA ZAKHMI KHUDA KE GHAR ME SHERE\nKIRDIGAAR
english translation text: The prayer mat weeps blood, and prayer itself\nis heartbroken; the Lion of the Creator has\nbeen wounded in the House of God.

arabic text: HAR TARAF SE AA RAHI HAI NOHA MATAM KI SADA\nSHEHRE KUFA HOGAYA HAIDER KEG HAM ME\nSOGWAR
english translation text: From every direction come the sounds\nof lament and matam; the city\nof Kufa mourns in grief for Haider.

arabic text: HAAYE KUFE KE YATEEMON KA SAHARA THA JO KAL\nAAJ KHUD USKE HI BACHE HAI YATEEMO ME SHUMAR
english translation text: Alas, the one who until yesterday supported Kufa's orphans—\ntoday his own children are counted among the orphans.

arabic text: EID KI AMAD SE PEHLE YEH QAYAMAT AAGAYI\nEID KA SHIYANE HAIDER KAR RAHE THE INTEZAAR
english translation text: Before the arrival of Eid, this Judgement Day descended;\nHaider's Shia had been waiting for Eid.

arabic text: HOGAYI TAREEK DUNYA SHABBAR O SHABBIR KI\nAA RAHA HAI ZAINABO KULSUM KO GHASH BAAR\nBAAR
english translation text: The world of Shabbar and\nShabbir has grown dark; Zainab\nand Kulsum repeatedly fall unconscious.

arabic text: MEHVE GIRYA HOGAYA ABBAS SAR KO PIT KAR\nKAMSINI ME AB UTHANA HAI YATEEMI KA YE BHAAR
english translation text: Beating his head, Abbas is lost in weeping;\nwhile still young, he must now bear the burden of orphanhood.

arabic text: AASMAAN SE BHI MUSALSAL AAYE AWAAZ E BUKA\nARSHA WAALE FARSH WAALE SAB HUWE HAIN\nBEQARAR
english translation text: From the heavens too comes a continuous cry\nof mourning; those upon the Throne and those\nupon the earth have all become restless.

arabic text: HAI DUA JAAYE NAJAF IS BAAR PURSE KE LIYE\nBIL YAQEEN SALMAN HUM NOHA KUNA MATAM\nGUZAAR
english translation text: This is the prayer: may we go to\nNajaf this year to offer condolences. Without doubt,\nO "Salman", we are lamenters and mourners.
